comparison.objective: Empty four concentrate bottles into a filling tank and shut its inlet at the target level; candidate selectively removes defective cartons from a belt.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2101 tests controlled pouring, bottle manipulation, fill-level timing and valve actuation. Candidate tests moving-target opposed grasping, articulated-flap clearance and spill-free whole-carton transport.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2101 requires emptied bottles, valve closure and final level within 12.5–13.5 cm, with overflow, spill, dropped bottle or tank movement causing zero. Candidate instead tracks carton-specific rejection/pass outcomes and whether loose contents cross a rim.
comparison.reason: Although both penalize spills and require process-state awareness, pouring and batch-level control are physically unrelated to carton interception.
